name: aegisai
description: AegisAI — Enterprise AI Security & Governance Gateway (monorepo root)

scripts.dev: npm run prep && npm run dev -w apps/api
scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w packages/shared-types -w packages/config -w packages/schemas
scripts.build:services: npm run build -w apps/identity-service && npm run build -w apps/security-audit-service && npm run build -w apps/privacy-service && npm run build -w apps/policy-service && npm run build -w apps/model-provider-service && npm run build -w apps/gateway-service
scripts.prep: npm run build:packages && npm run build:services
scripts.build: npm run prep && npm run build -w apps/api -w apps/frontend
scripts.db:migrate:identity: npm run build -w apps/identity-service && npm run migrate -w apps/identity-service
scripts.test: npm run prep && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:watch: npm run prep && npm run test:watch -w apps/api
scripts.typecheck: npm run prep && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.lint: echo 'lint: not configured yet (Phase 0 placeholder)' && exit 0
scripts.db:migrate: npm run build:services && npm run migrate -w apps/identity-service && npm run migrate -w apps/gateway-service && npm run migrate -w apps/policy-service && npm run migrate -w apps/model-provider-service
